$comment: Pinned, verbatim content inputs. The build script refuses to run if a checksum differs. Update a checksum only after replacing a file with a newer verbatim copy from its official source and reviewing its licence.

quran.name: Tanzil Quran Text (Uthmani)
quran.license: CC BY 3.0 — verbatim copies only; changing the text is not allowed; source (Tanzil.net) must be indicated with a link.
quran.retrievedVia: PyPI package pyquran==1.0.1 (pyquran/QuranCorpus/quran-uthmani.xml), md5 6aae945d556a1b28cfe682c0ea5ab518 matches the md5 file shipped beside it. Copyright block intact.
quran.upgradeNote: Tanzil has published newer versions of this text since 1.0.2. Before release, download the current quran-uthmani.xml from tanzil.net/download, replace this file, update sha256/version here and rebuild.
